entries.title: Community forums
entries.description: Communities now have a forum with categories, where you can start threads and reply to others. Community managers can set up the categories in community settings.

entries.title: See the latest library updates on the landing page
entries.description: The landing page now shows what people on Orbis just started, finished, or caught up on, so you can see what everyone's into right now.

entries.title: Community and profile options in one menu
entries.description: Settings, reporting, and leaving a community are now gathered in a single options menu on community pages and profiles, keeping the header tidy.

entries.title: Easier sign-in code entry
entries.description: When you enter a two-factor code, each digit gets its own box, so it's easier to type or paste the code from your authenticator app.
